name: Jindal Saw Ltd
about: Jindal Saw Ltd manufactures LSAW pipes, HSAW pipes, DI pipes, seamless pipes and pellets.[1]
keyPoints:
Market Leadership
The company is a global leader in the coated and bare pipe industry, with a strong track record of supplying a wide range of pipe products to major clients both in India and internationally. [1] It is the world's third-largest producer of rust-free iron pipes. [2]

pros: Stock is trading at 0.86 times its book value
Company has delivered good profit growth of 23.9% CAGR over last 5 years
